newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia says 96/97 first-half C/A deficit widens.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia says 96/97 first-half C/A deficit widens.

text.p: Indonesian Finance Minister Mar'ie Muhammad said on Tuesday the country's current account deficit widened to $4.521 billion in the first half of fiscal 1996/97 (April-March) from $3.749 billion in the same period last year.

"In the first half of 1996/97, the current account deficit was $4.521 billion or an increase of 20.6 percent from the same period in the previous year (when the deficit was) $3.749 billion," Mar'ie said in a report to the parliamentary budget commission.
He said total exports in first half of 1996/97 were $25.203 billion and imports were $23.069 billion.
He said the deficit of services was $6.655 billion.
